summary: OMT bulk loading rounded the per-axis cluster count upward, producing too many child clusters and oversized internal nodes. The fix rounds downward to correct that overpartitioning. The one-line implementation reversal is exact and unique. Blocked: no detecting upstream test was found at this revision. The fix adds no tests; existing bulk-loading tests check element preservation and allocation capacity, while rtree::test::test_bulk_load_crash explicitly disables maximum-node-size checking. No builds or tests were run.
